limits: No third-party installation-source packet is supplied; source/command verification is unobserved.
No screenshot pixels or real phone evidence is supplied.
All fixture text and changed source bodies are included. Other unchanged source is represented by hashes. Inherited fixture source must not be credited as newly authored actor work.

Tool events emitted by exec JSONL are included, but the CLI can omit image-view calls and returned image blocks. Their absence does not establish that screenshot review was skipped or a review claim was unsupported. Without supplemental proof, the visual-review observation is unobserved; do not infer pixel quality.
Subprocess file reads may not be individually logged; configuration isolation is not a read jail.
Baseline-only input is not arm-blinded. Report further unblinding cues.
